content: Hi, how can i assist you today?
Traffic cameras blink patterns to guide me.
Traffic systems follow set cycles. Have you timed the intervals—green, yellow, red—to compare with typical sequences?
I haven’t timed anything, just sensed a pattern.
A stopwatch across several cycles would give a baseline.
If the timing shifts when I arrive, that proves it, right?
Signals can be adaptive for flow. If patterns change even when you’re stationary at different times, that points to normal scheduling rather than guidance.
So test multiple intersections and times.
